name: Boulder Dash-XL 3D
description:
Distribution of this software ended at 10:00 on Wednesday, February 24, 2021.

----------------------------------------------
The classic action puzzle game "Balder Dash" released in 1984 has been further powered up. It will be re-released as "Balder Dash XL 3D" for Nintendo 3DS!

With the charm of a classic puzzle game and the graphics unique to the Nintendo 3DS, it's an exciting game that everyone from old game fans to new gamers can enjoy.

Players control two main characters, Rockford and Crystal, as they explore more than 100 caves full of mystery and danger. Collect diamonds, defeat enemies that appear one after another, avoid falling rocks, and clear the stage within a set time.

There are 5 game modes, including a retro mode that is close to the original version released in 1984. Enjoy a nostalgic yet new puzzle game that anyone can fall in love with because it is classic and simple.
